line.comment: * chance to spawn additional Xenon defenders for 1 Xenon station.
* Core of the Xenon Empire around the OCV portal tends to get reinforced first and stronger
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Reworked.
* - Defender tracking now stores fleet leader instead of a boolean.
* - Reduced stronghold capital concentration: 2 M2 -> 1 M2, 2 M7 -> 1 M7
* - Number of garrisons is now dependent on game difficulty.
* - Removed random downgrade chance.
* Return if no Xenon sectors remain.
* Total number of extra Defender fleets gets capped at X% of number of Xenon sectors, default 30%. Default percentage must range between 30-100%.
* After difficulty scaling, the final percentage may exceed 100%. This is intentional because Xenon sectors contain multiple stations, allowing multiple garrisons per sector.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Percentage now scales by difficulty. Easy: 0.8x, normal: 1.0x, hard: 1.5x, insane (non-OCV): 2x, insane (OCV alignment): 1.0x.
* Easy: 0.8x base percentage
* Normal: 1.0x base percentage
* Hard: 1.5x base percentage
* Insane: If allied with OCV, the percentage is 1.0x. Otherwise, 2x.
* Count active extra defender leaders.
* Only 1 extra fleet per Xenon station. If it is the maelstrom sector, then check the portal instead since only 1 garrison will spawn there.
* Maelstrom sector spawns 1 fleet at the portal instead of at the station.
* Only 1 extra fleet per Xenon location. If the stored leader is dead, the location is eligible again.
* We can get more defenders. ZH.Get.Distance.Portal returns null for the portal sector itself.
* Maelstrom sector itself never gets extra Xenon defenders...
* unless there's more than 2 gates (including the maelstrom, as it technically counts as a gate) AND at least 1 adjacent sector is not Xenon.
* Unknown sectors are considered unsafe as they could be taken over by enemy forces.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2d: Player sector before player has joined the OCV counts as an enemy.
* Xenon sectors are safe.
* Player sectors are enemies only before the player joins the OCV.
* All other adjacent owners are enemies, including unknown and Phanon sectors.
* At this point, the sector has adjacent enemies and we need to spawn a fleet. Spawn a larger one at the portal, not at a station.

line.comment: * Adjacent to Maelstrom; needs strongest defense.
* Core of the Xenon Empire up to 4 jumps around the portal. Medium Defense.
* Periphery sectors. Lowest extra defense.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Strongholds now spawn 1 of either M2 and 1 of either M7. Non-capital ship amounts increased by up to 50%.
* Spawn the Z and either a C or Q.
* Spawn the I instead and either a C or Q.
* Spawn our best fleet. Only Xenon elites (+25-50% more than standard stronghold), with some OCV ships mixed into the fleet.
* Since only 1 fleet spawns for the maelstrom, the number of ships is effectively doubled compared to a stronghold.
* Maelstrom sector spawns elite forces to better protect the portal.
* Store leader object. If leader dies, this location can spawn a new fleet later.
* Maelstrom garrisons are tracked by the portal; normal garrisons are tracked by the station.
